page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-48 is a virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 186.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU. This configuration provides dedicated compute resources without shared-core performance degradation.

This instance type does not include bundled local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the c4d-standard-48 offers a balanced allocation of compute and memory, aligning with general-purpose workloads. It is designed for multi-threaded applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-scale database hosting where local storage and GPU acceleration are not required.
